⭐️ Telegram Premium Payments FAQ

Q: How do I subscribe?
A: Just tap the button below this message to check out the subscriptions plans and sign up. You can also go to Settings, then click on Telegram Premium and tap 'Subscribe'.

Q: What are my payment options?
A: You can either pay through the App Store / Google Play or directly with your card using @PremiumBot. The app will automatically suggest the most convenient payment method for you.

Note: If you can't access @PremiumBot through your app, you can open it using Telegram Web.

Q: What sets @PremiumBot apart from App Store / Google Play payments?
A: @PremiumBot works just like any other online payment method, allowing you to use your credit or debit card. It also supports local payment options in some regions, unlike the App Store or Google Play.

Q: Any discounts available?
A: Absolutely! We love a good deal too-our yearly Premium plans are discounted by up to4️⃣0️⃣🔤. Plus, all subscriptions via @PremiumBot come at a lower cost since there are no extra fees from Apple or Google.

Q: How do I pay with cryptocurrency?
A: You can buy Telegram Premium using cryptocurrency right here.

TELEGRAM 10.1

🆕 Stories in Channels, View-Once Media and More
https://telegram.org/blog/channel-stories

Stories for Channels
• Telegram users can grant their favorite channels the ability to post stories by giving them boosts. Channel Info > More > Statistics > Boosts
• Telegram Premium now includes one boost that can be assigned to any channel.
• Once your channel unlocks stories, admins with the relevant rights who have a Telegram Premium subscription can post by tapping the ⊕ icon on the Channel Info page.
• Admins will also see a 'Post Story As' option when posting stories from their chat list.

Reaction Stickers in Stories
• To add a reaction sticker, tap the 💭 icon in the sticker panel, then choose an emoji from the dozens of options in the window.

Your Music in Stories
• From the sticker panel, tap 'Audio' and select a file, then adjust the track to select any section. In video stories you can keep the original sound as well as move your added audio track to any point.

View-Once Media
• In any 1-on-1 chat, tapping the ① icon in the media editor lets you choose how long your photo or video will be visible after opening - from View Once to 30 seconds. View-Once media is permanently deleted from the chat when the recipient opens it.

New Login Alerts
• Whenever someone logs in to your account, Telegram sends a notification to all your devices. To make this even more noticeable, new logins now display this alert at the top of your chat list. t.me/tgbeta/4763

[Tips] How to embed X, Instagram, TikTok videos on Telegram

• X (Twitter)
Change x.com ➔ fixupx.com or fixvx.com in your link
Change twitter.com ➔ fxtwitter.com or vxtwitter.com in your link

• X (Twitter) on Instant View
Change x.com ➔ i.fixupx.com in your link

• Instagram
Change instagram.com ➔ ddinstagram.com in your link

• TikTok
Change tiktok.com ➔ vxtiktok.com in your link

Note: some links may not work
More Info: fixupx.com, fixvx.com, ddinstagram.com, vxtiktok.com

📰 Dodo Pizza goes to court after Telegram ignores objections 13:21

Dodo Pizza, a Russian pizzeria chain, initially owned the @dodopizza username on Telegram since 2018. However, due to channel inactivity, they lost it. Following Fragment's launch, a prominent TON investor acquired the username through a public auction.

In early June, Dodo Pizza decided to reclaim the username. Communication breakdown ensued, leading Dodo Pizza to file a lawsuit against the username owner, and even named Telegram as a defendant, hinting at unfair competition.

The lawsuits were filed in Russia because the company is Russian and the branded channel is believed to be for Russian users.

It’s a multifaceted scenario with legal, technical, and community-driven dimensions. We’ll see how it unfolds and whether it impacts web3 norms.

📰 Telegram CEO Pavel Durov arrested at airport near Paris, French media reports

Durov is suspected of failing to take action to curb the criminal use of his platform.
